page.overview:
Who is Narenwin Barda?

Narenwin Barda is an Aes Sedai of the Yellow Ajah.

She is thin, very short and with a square face. She usually is so quiet that people could forget she was there; she was also mousy around other sisters.

Nerenwin is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of " or "., Narenwhin Barda}} The lower possible strength matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability a the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

Being a Yellow sister also usually indicates a skill in Healing.
